# launchd labels the reduce-simulator-services action turns off inside the iOS Simulator (BE-0517).
# One label per line; `#` starts a comment. A label stays here only under a category whose reason
# says why no showcase scenario needs it. The experiment named 173 labels; the four left out
# (`swcd`: universal links, `assetsd`: the photo library behind the photo picker, `ind`,
# `storagedatad`: no reason we could write) stay on. So do SpringBoard, `backboardd`, notification
# delivery, privacy permissions (TCC), the pasteboard, and location services, which no category
# below names.

# Push delivery from Apple's servers. `simctl push` hands a payload to the device directly.
com.apple.apsd

# Diagnostics, analytics, and reporting uploads. Nothing in a run reads them.

com.apple.feedbackd
com.apple.geoanalyticsd
com.apple.rtcreportingd
com.apple.securityuploadd
com.apple.proactiveeventtrackerd
com.apple.parsec-fbf
